title: Book Two · Chapter 89: The Picture Mei Keeps
story:
The class prepares a wall of short book notices. Each group chooses one book. They write two clear lines about it. They add a small picture. Ronan wants Mei's tree drawing for his group's notice.

He finds her at lunch with the drawing open on her desk.

“That one would look good on the wall.”

“It is for my own book.”

“We can use it for a week.”

Mei puts her hand beside the page. “I want to keep it here.”

Ronan looks at the picture again. The tree has a wide dark trunk. Little gaps of light show between its leaves. His own tree would be a stick with a round top.

“Can you make another?”

“Not today.”

“But it is for the group.”

“I have my own group.”

Ronan forgot about her group. Now he remembers. Mei closes her book. She is not angry, but the picture is no longer in front of him.

He walks back to Jun. Their chosen book is about a child in a garden. There is a small gate on the cover and a basket beside it.

“Mei cannot do our picture,” Ronan says.

“She said no?”

“Yes.”

Jun takes a pencil. “We can draw a gate.”

Ronan watches him make two posts and three bars. The bars lean. He takes a second scrap and tries. His posts are straighter, but one bar comes out through the side.

They choose Jun's gate and add a path. One of the other children draws the basket. Ronan writes the title above it. The picture is simple. But everyone can see the gate, path and basket.

Miss Wu reads their two lines. She asks them to make the child's name clearer. Ronan changes the first line. Jun checks it against the book.

When the notice goes on the wall, the gate tilts a little to the left. Ronan wants to take it down and straighten it. Jun straightens the whole paper. Now the gate leans less.

Mei passes later with her own group. Their notice has a bowl of fruit on it. She stops at Ronan's gate.

“I like the basket,” she says.

“Not mine,” Ronan says. He points to the other child.

That evening, he makes a tree in his birthday book. It still has a round top, but he adds small spaces between the leaves. He leaves the page there for himself. On the next page, he draws a leaning gate. He puts a very straight basket beside it.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

picture＝图画；keep＝保留；gate＝栅栏门。

## 理解问题

1. Mei为什么不把画交给小组？
2. Ronan怎样继续这项普通任务？

## 读句子

**Mei / closes / her book.** Mei／合上／她的本子。
